Interests include breakfasts with eggs and goat milk, classic egg salad, quiche, and beginner-friendly goat-milk cheesemaking. They initially considered chèvre but are now more interested in goat-milk ricotta. Fresh ricotta ideas discussed: lasagna, cannoli, ravioli, cheesecake, savory pastries, and flavor variations. Keep food-safety and home-cheesemaking guidance cautious and evidence-based; clarify temperatures/times, sanitation, refrigeration/freezing, and when to consult local experts or regulators.

They plan to build a predator-resistant chicken-coop fence this weekend. They have also had mites and flies around the coop.
